article.story: GREEN BAY, Wis. -- — Ne’quan Brown scored 14 points as Green Bay opened its campaign Monday with a 94-51 victory over Lawrence. Brown shot 4 for 6 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and 4 for 5 from the free-throw line for the Phoenix. Marcus Hall went 4 for 7 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, to add 12 points. Stewart Erhart II went 3 for 6 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, to finish with nine points. C.J. Campbell led the Vikings with 14 points. Lawrence also got six points from Nolan Koch. Nicholas Gouriotis added six points. Up next Green Bay visits Cincinnati on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
